title: Fire Alarm Service and Maintenance Engineer - Brighton & Hove
locationText: Brighton and Hove, England, United Kingdom
description:
Fire Alarm Service & Maintenance Engineer
Field Based - Brighton & Hove & Local Catchment | Circa £35,000 + Benefits and Additional Earning Potential
Company Overview:
Firetecnics is one of London's most trusted, LPCB-certified fire safety companies, with one of the best reputations in the industry built up over more than 35 years. We are the go-to fire safety partner for residential and commercial property professionals, delivering fast, reliable solutions that ensure full compliance and complete peace of mind.
As part of the Helix International Group, Firetecnics combines specialist fire-safety expertise with the capability and backing of a wider risk, compliance and technology group.
We provide fire detection, installation, service, maintenance and wider compliance solutions, combining technical expertise with responsive, personalised customer service.
Role Overview:
Firetecnics is strengthening its regional Service & Maintenance capability and is looking for Fire Alarm Service & Maintenance Engineers based in and around Brighton & Hove. The role is designed around stronger local coverage, with engineers working predominantly within defined regional customer clusters rather than routinely travelling across the whole South East.
Your core focus will be planned fire alarm servicing and maintenance, reactive fault-finding, diagnostics and remedial works. We are looking for engineers with credible hands-on fire alarm experience, a methodical approach to faults and the ambition to continue developing technically.
We also want to broaden our engineering capability across AOV systems and emergency lighting. Previous experience is advantageous but not essential where you have the right fire alarm foundations and willingness to learn; training and support will be provided where required.

title: Estimator / Operations Coordinator
description:
VirtueStaff is seeking a Spanish Bilingual Estimator / Operations Coordinator to oversee project logistics and labor estimations for a final construction cleaning services company. In this dual-function role, the coordinator will analyze construction plan unit matrices to generate accurate labor estimates in Excel while serving as the primary operational link between field crews and site superintendents. The ideal candidate manages approximately five concurrent projects, ensuring job site readiness, material ordering, PPE compliance, and remote crew accountability.
Responsibilities

• Review construction plans and unit matrices daily to calculate labor requirements and build standardized proposals in Excel.

• Submit bids through the company CRM and follow up with clients to confirm receipt and address project scope requirements.

• Conduct daily morning check-ins with field crews in Spanish to verify attendance, readiness, and compliance with project scopes.

• Communicate directly with construction project managers and superintendents in English to relay field instructions and resolve quality concerns.

• Coordinate remote crew staffing adjustments, resolve site complaints, and order job site supplies or required PPE.

• Assist the Director of Operations with new project startups across concurrent active job sites.

Requirements

• Fluent bilingual English and Spanish communication skills (verbal and written).

• Professional background in property management, home services, janitorial/cleaning services, or labor-based operational environments preferred.

• Strong organizational skills with proven experience coordinating multiple active projects and field teams simultaneously.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, PDF plan viewers, and CRM software.

• Comfortable working with basic arithmetic, estimating formulas, and structured SOPs.

• Strong problem-solving abilities, professional demeanor when handling client concerns, and independent operational judgment.

• Spanish bilingual required.

Benefits

• Work From Home

• Performance Bonus

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Data / Ingestion Engineer for our client, a consultancy that helps banks and insurers transform their operations through AI, automation, and advanced analytics, with a strong focus on Anti-Financial Crime (fraud prevention, AML, KYC) and enterprise AI platforms . You will join their delivery for a Dutch insurance client .
We're looking for an engineer with deep experience building robust ingestion pipelines for unstructured documents and integrating OCR and document extraction technologies. You will turn high volumes of insurance documents (PDFs, scans, emails, Office files) into structured, high-quality, AI-ready data that feeds downstream RAG and AI models.
This is a long-term remote-first contract position for candidates based in Europe.
Responsibilities

• Design and implement scalable pipelines for ingesting high-volume unstructured insurance documents (PDFs, scans, emails, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

• Build connectors to document sources such as SharePoint and email.

• Integrate, configure, and optimise OCR and document parsing technologies to extract high-accuracy text and layouts.

• Build automated workflows for text cleaning, normalisation, semantic chunking, and metadata tagging.

• Design vector storage schemas and robust retrieval mechanisms (RAG) to feed downstream AI models.

• Ensure document processing pipelines meet enterprise security and low-latency SLA requirements.

• Build automated error monitoring and extraction validation loops that flag low-confidence OCR outputs.

• Apply engineering best practices across the pipeline lifecycle: version control, CI/CD, and testing.

Work Conditions

• Start Date : ASAP

• Location : Remote within Europe (CEE preferred)

• Long-term contract-based role: until July 2027 with possible extension

• Contract with EU LCC

Requirements

• 5-10 years' experience in data engineering.

• Proven experience building data processing and document ingestion pipelines on public cloud platforms.

• Hands-on experience processing unstructured documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, scans, emails).

• Experience building connectors to enterprise sources such as SharePoint and email.

• Practical experience with document extraction / OCR tools, e.g. AWS Textract or equivalent.

• Strong engineering practices: Git, CI/CD, automated testing.

• Experience in banking or insurance is an advantage.

Technical Requirements
Mandatory

• Python, SQL

• AWS: S3, Step Functions, CloudWatch

• OCR / document extraction: AWS Textract or equivalent

• Unstructured document processing and ingestion pipelines

• Git, CI/CD, testing

Nice to have

• Vector databases and RAG architectures

• Azure, Databricks

• Financial services / insurance domain experience

Highlights
If you are passionate about turning unstructured documents into AI-ready data, and want to help leading financial institutions fight financial crime with AI, this role is for you!

title: Product Sourcing Engineer, Core Tech
tags: Hardware Operations : Supply Chain : Product Sourcing Engineering
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

The Product Sourcing Engineer drives the strategic supply network development and cost management of Anduril’s product hardware across their lifecycles, by collaborating with suppliers and cross-functionally, including folks in engineering, quality, and manufacturing.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Conduct supplier selection for a specific product, leveraging our approved supplier list

• Partner with strategic suppliers to accelerate product development via activities such as:

• Concept scoping to quickly solidify requirements

• Feature trade-off / trade tables

• Should cost / Clean sheet models

• Joint design development, via clear statements of work

• Simulation of mechanical & electronics designs

• Drive the development and consolidation of a manufacturing BOM, working with Quality & Manufacturing, to ramp production internally and with our suppliers with high flexibility

• Manage the CAPEX throughout NPI

• Conduct value-stream mapping to optimize supply network lead time and flexibility

• Complete the BOM risk assessment, include alternate component sourcing, etc.

• Ensure completion of all component qualifications, ahead of production

• Reduce complexity: commonality optimization & component/supplier rationalization

• Lead all cost engineering activities to converge the bottoms-up cost curve to product cost, maximizing the total cost of ownership (TCO) across the product lifecycle

• Manage ad-hoc cost issues e.g., tariffs / import export cost, and cost inflation

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, engineering, or related technical field

• 3+ years of experience in sourcing engineering, supplier engagement and development, or design of electronics and/or mechanical devices

• Domain expertise of value/procurement engineering or TCO-related work at the component & product level

• Ability to travel 10% - 40% of the time, variable based on program needs

• Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master's degree or advanced technical degree in mechanical engineering

• Deeper experience within:

• Design & development of electronics and/or mechanical devices

• Advanced sourcing activities, including stints as commodity/sourcing managers

• Supplier development (technology, process, supply chain, etc.)

• Early supplier engagement, ahead of product/engineering requirement realization

• Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment

• Exposure to working in a fast-pace, start-up environment

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. TS clearance

$129,000 — $171,000 USD

title: Credit Analyst Intern (Jan 2027)
description:
ABOUT LENDABLE

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a 12 week internship program starting from 5th January 2027

Salary - £48,000 (per annum)

Thinking about a move into credit? Our 3-month Credit Analyst internship is built for early-career professionals from any background who want to test-drive the role before committing to a change.

We’re looking for a someone who is great with numbers and loves problem solving to come and apply your skills in a start up environment and have a big impact on our business and how we do things.

What you'll be doing

- Use your analytical and problem-solving skills to generate key insights from data, and use that insight to drive meaningful change in our strategy

- Using data and modelling to ground assumptions for our NPV model, such as predicting what default rates will be in the future, and using that to inform our lending deicsions

- Using data and analytics to drive decisions about who we should lend to, and how much we should lend to them, and how that changes with the economy and competition changes

- Conducting hypothesis testing, and using your findings to change how we do things in areas such as lending strategy, pricing, and fraud detection

- Presenting your findings to senior leaders in the company, then work with the product/tech team to get them implemented

What we're looking for

- Must have coding skills in Python or SQL

- Someone that loves numbers! You’ll be working with numbers every single day in this role so you’ll be able to demonstrate your ability to work with complex data sets, analyse them and draw insights

- You’ll have a natural curiosity and love to dig into things to understand how they work

- Startup mindset. We’re a fast-growth tech startup so you’ll be super excited to work in an entrepreneurial environment and have a real impact on the business

Interview Process

- 15-minute online test

- Coding Take Home Task

- Remote (video call) Task Debrief (60 mins)

- Remote (video call) case study (60 mins)

- In-person case study (60 min) + Culture Add Conversation (15 minutes) + a chance to meet other recent grads over lunch (30-45 minutes)

LIFE AT LENDABLE

- Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

- Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

- Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyon

title: Performance Marketing Manager (BBS869)
description:

You will replace an existing agency, take full ownership of paid channel performance, diagnose what is missing strategically, and drive D2C growth back into high gear working directly with the brand's digital and communications team.
This is not an execution-only role. You will own the strategy as well as the management, identifying gaps in funnel mix, retargeting, and upper and lower funnel balance, and directing what needs to change. Creative assets come from an in-house designer based on your briefs. If you have hands-on Meta ads experience, a data-driven growth mindset, and prefer the ownership and visibility of an in-house role over the siloed structure of an agency, this role is a strong fit.
Why You'll Want to Join

• You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

•
Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

• Observance of Holidays per company guidelines

•
100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

• This role requires meaningful overlap with Australian business hours

• Own the full paid media function for the Australian market of a globally recognized skincare brand

• High-ownership performance marketing role with direct impact on D2C revenue and brand growth

What You'll Work On
Paid Media Strategy and Platform Ownership

• Own strategy and hands-on management across Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google, TikTok, and Amazon ads for the Australian market

• Diagnose gaps in the current paid media strategy including retargeting coverage, funnel mix, and upper and lower funnel balance

• Direct what needs to change and implement improvements with speed and clarity

• Manage a significant annual paid media budget with full accountability for performance and spend efficiency

Creative Briefing and Asset Direction

• Identify creative needs based on strategic priorities and brief the in-house designer accordingly

• Ensure creative assets align with platform best practices and campaign objectives

• Test creative hypotheses and iterate based on performance data

Performance Analysis and Reporting

• Monitor campaign performance across all platforms and surface actionable insights regularly

• Track key metrics including ROAS, CAC, CTR, conversion rate, and revenue contribution by channel

• Communicate performance clearly to the digital and communications team with recommended next steps

• Stay current on platform updates, algorithm changes, and emerging AI ad tools that could improve performance

What You Bring

• Proven hands-on Meta and Facebook ads experience; this is the primary hard requirement for this role

• Experience managing paid media in-house at an e-commerce brand of similar scale and spend level; in-house brand experience is preferred over agency-only backgrounds given the tendency for agency roles to be siloed by platform

• Comfortable owning paid media strategy end to end including diagnosing gaps, setting direction, and executing changes independently

• Data-driven and growth-minded with the ability to pick up a new market and brand quickly

• Experience managing significant ad budgets with clear accountability for performance outcomes

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills for briefing creative, reporting to stakeholders, and collaborating with a distributed team

• Meaningful overlap with Australian business hours

Nice to Have

• Experience across Google, TikTok, and Amazon ads alongside Meta

• Familiarity with emerging AI ad platforms and tools

• Background in beauty, skincare, wellness, or consumer DTC brands

• Experience transitioning a brand from agency-managed to in-house paid media management

title: Principal Engineer Capacity/Compute
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry - spanning multiple accelerator families, cpu families and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first-party and third-party compute.

As an engineer on Capacity Engineering, you will build the production systems that power this work: data pipelines that ingest and normalize telemetry from heterogeneous cloud environments, observability tooling that gives the org real-time visibility into fleet health, and performance instrumentation that measures how efficiently every major workload uses the hardware it’s running on. You will be expected to write production-quality code every day, operate alongside Kubernetes-native infrastructure at meaningful scale, and directly influence decisions around one of Anthropic’s largest areas of spend.

You’ll collaborate closely with research engineering, infrastructure, inference, and finance teams. The work requires someone who can move between data engineering, systems engineering, and observability with comfort - and who thrives in a high-autonomy, high-ambiguity environment.

This is a pipeline role feeding four areas. Depending on your background and business priority, you’ll focus primarily in one, but the boundaries are fluid and the problems overlap:

• Data platform Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Correctness, completeness, and latency are the job, not a footnote. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so it's product work as much as engineering: defining schema contracts, making data discoverable, and figuring out what people actually need.

• Planning Knowing what the fleet has, where it's going, and what's in the way. Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation. Kubernetes operations on one side, cross-team coordination on the other.

• Efficiency Measuring and improving how effectively every major workload uses the hardware it runs on. Instrumenting utilization across training, inference, and eval systems, building benchmarking infrastructure, establishing per-config baselines, and working directly with system-owning teams to close the gaps. The metric has to be good enough that the team on the hook for it agrees with the number.

• Attribution and forecasting Connecting what the fleet costs to what the business is doing with it. Reconciling CSP billing exports against vendor telemetry and internal systems with mismatched schemas, attributing spend to the workloads and teams that generate it, and turning inference demand signals and research roadmaps into a defensible compute plan. Efficiency metrics have to survive contact with finance: stripped of pure demand and unit-price effects, reproducible month over month, and legible to a CFO.

Key responsibilities

• Build the planning and allocation stack - the tools leadership uses to allocate capacity, teams use to plan against their allocations, and the scheduler enforces. Cross-region and cross-provider placement, guardrails, queueing, occupancy KPIs.

• Drive the efficiency program

title: Marketing Lead
description:
bunch https://www.bunch.capital/ is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

YOUR ROLE

As Marketing Lead, you turn marketing into a reliable source of qualified pipeline across the UK, Luxembourg and Germany. You report to the Co-Founder and own the marketing plan, budget and team.

Our buyers are GPs, CFOs, COOs and fund operations teams at VC and PE managers. Trust in this market comes from expertise, references and the institutions they already rely on, and almost nobody speaks to the CFO and operations team directly. We will. The founders set the company narrative; you build the engine that carries it to market.

TOP PRIORITIES

OWN MARKETING’S PIPELINE CONTRIBUTION

- Set marketing’s pipeline target by market with the CEO and own the result: qualified pipeline in euros across the UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

- Define and run the marketing plan and budget for each market, and decide which programmes to scale and which to stop.

- Grow our presence beyond our current client base and build our position with larger fund managers.

BUILD THE ENGINE ACROSS THREE VECTORS

- Content and credibility: a weekly publishing cadence built on what our fund specialists, founders and clients know (operational deep dives, migration and capital-call guides, case studies with named clients), co-publications and webinars with the institutions and voices our buyers trust, and the data and insights lane: bunch as the source the market and journalists call about European private markets operations. You orchestrate; you run the writer.

- Field: an events programme you produce in-house for fund CFOs and COOs, who rarely attend the investor events, built as a ladder: a 10-person series per market, seller-owned events, partner events with law firms, auditors and banks, and from there larger flagship formats, eventually a bunch conference.

- Growth and online: with our Growth Marketing Manager and our sales ops and data team, the digital channels, pooled audiences and the HubSpot attribution and MQL→SQL layer that turn attention into qualified pipeline.

OWN POSITIONING AND PRODUCT MARKETING, WITH PRODUCT

- Positioning and messaging by tier, release go-to-market, and sales enablement (one-pagers, battlecards, demo narratives). Product owns the roadmap and release notes; you own how the market hears about them.

- Become an expert in our product: sit with client onboarding and the fund specialists until you can demo and explain the platform yourself.

WORK HAND IN HAND WITH SALES

- Bring market insight back to the commercial team: what our buyers read, discuss and care about, in a weekly market brief you own.

BUILD THE FUNCTION

- Set up the marketing scoreboard (attribution, shared definitions of MQL, SQL and sourced vs influenced pipeline, reporting) with our sales ops and data team.

- Lead and grow the team: a Growth Marketing Manager today, a writer on retainer, an events coordinator as the series scales; manage agencies and freelancers.

ABOUT YOU

You have built a marketing function or content programme from near zero: hired for it, set its budget, chose its agencies, and it kept running when you stepped back. Consulting or GTM-practice years count; private markets experience puts you at the top of our list.

title: Bereichsleiter Betrieb & Sicherheit (m/w/d)
description:
Als Leiter Betrieb und Sicherheit (m/w/d) verantwortest du das operative Herz von FlixTrain: von der Betriebs- und Produktionsplanung über die Leitstelle, die in Echtzeit den Betrieb steuert, bis hin zur Betriebssicherheit, der Flottendisposition sowie dem Partner- und Qualitätsmanagement. Du sorgst für einen sicheren, pünktlichen, zuverlässigen und kundenfreundlichen Zugbetrieb und baust das Führungsteam über alle operativen Funktionen hinweg auf - mit direkter Berichtslinie an den CEO.
Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die unternehmerisch handelt und entscheidet, für die Sache brennt, mit anpackt und Lust am Aufbau von Strukturen, Prozessen und Optimierungen hat. Bei uns kannst du den Betrieb des größten privaten Fernverkehrsplayers in Deutschland aufbauen.

Über die Rolle

• Du verantwortest Betriebsplanung, Produktionskonzepte sowie Schicht- und Personaleinsatzplanung für einen zuverlässigen und sicheren Betrieb.

• Du führst die Leitstelle und steuerst damit den laufenden Betrieb, das Störungs- und Abweichungsmanagement sowie die Disposition des Personals - mit ruhigem Kopf in jeder betrieblichen Lage.

• Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem Safety Manager die Eisenbahnsicherheit, die regulatorische Compliance und die Sicherheitskultur - inklusive der Safety-Teams und Betriebskontrolleure.

• Du stellst die Flottenverfügbarkeit und Flottendisposition sicher - in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Instandhaltungspartnern, die als zentrale Ressource gestellt werden.

• Du definierst unsere Servicestandards und die operative Qualität und sorgst für deren kontinuierliche Optimierung - inklusive Sauberkeit, Reinigung sowie Ver- und Entsorgung.

• Du steuerst operative Partner und Subunternehmer, entwickelst einheitliche Standards mit Partner-EVUs, optimierst Schnittstellen und treibst Prozessexzellenz voran.

• Du definierst mit deinem Team die Anforderungen an unsere Software-Entwicklung, Automatisierung und Digitalisierung von Abläufen, harmonisierst die Software-Landschaft und sorgst für eine gute Anwendbarkeit über alle Funktionen hinweg.

• Du verantwortest das operative Budget und die entscheidenden KPIs - etwa Zuverlässigkeit, Sicherheit, Pünktlichkeit, Sauberkeit, Schichtbesetzung und Flottenverfügbarkeit.

Über Dich

• Du bringst ein unternehmerisches Mindset und echte Leidenschaft fürs Aufbauen mit - du brennst für das Ergebnis und packst mit an, um es Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen.

• Du hast insgesamt rund zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung gesammelt und in dieser Zeit Verantwortung und Gestaltungskraft aufgebaut.

• Erfahrung im Eisenbahnumfeld ist für uns gesetzt - idealerweise verbunden mit operativem Verständnis für Disposition und Planung.

• Du bringst Führungserfahrung in operativen Funktionen sowie Erfahrung im Aufbau von Teams und Strukturen mit.

• Du verfügst über verhandlungssicheres Deutsch.

• Idealerweise hast du dein Handwerk bei der Eisenbahn von Grund auf gelernt und dich anschließend weiterentwickelt - zum Beispiel über eine Station in der Beratung hin zu einer Führungsrolle im operativen Umfeld.

• Wünschenswert sind außerdem: Erfahrung im Skalieren von Betrieben in einem Wachstumsumfeld, ein Hintergrund in Eisenbahn-Sicherheitsmanagementsystemen (SMS) und Erfahrung im Flottenmanagement.

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze - auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

• Gestaltungsspielraum mit Mandat : Eine Schlüsselrolle mit direkter Berichtslinie an den CEO und dem Auftrag, den Betrieb des größten privaten Fernverkehrsanbieters Deutschlands maßgeblich aufzubauen - dein Einfluss ist unmittelbar sichtbar.

• Vertrauensarbeitszeit : Wir arbeiten ergebnisorientiert und messen an dem, was du bewegst - nicht an der Stechuhr.

• Hybrides Arbeitsmodell : Drei Tage Office und zwei Tage remote pro Woche - für die Nähe zum Team und die Flexibilität, die eine Führungsrolle braucht.

title: Senior Database Developer (Oracle & PostgreSQL)
description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We are seeking an experienced Senior Database Developer to lead and support Oracle to PostgreSQL/Aurora PostgreSQL migration initiatives. The role involves deep hands-on work across SQL refactoring, schema conversion, DMS operations, performance tuning, and post-go-live stabilization. The candidate will work closely with application teams, cloud engineers, and stakeholders to ensure a smooth, performant, and compliant migration.
What you will do?

• Refactor and convert Oracle SQL, PL/SQL, and database objects to PostgreSQL-compatible SQL/PLpgSQL.

• Identify, troubleshoot, and fix database-related application bugs.

• Perform query optimization for PostgreSQL (execution plans, indexing strategies, query rewrites).

• Support and monitor AWS DMS during full load and CDC phases.

• Diagnose and resolve DMS data and performance issues.

• Perform data validation and reconciliation between Oracle and PostgreSQL.

• Collaborate with application teams to align SQL behavior and performance expectations.

What are we looking for?

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience as an Oracle/PostgreSQL DBA and database developer.

• Strong experience with Oracle Database and PostgreSQL / Aurora PostgreSQL.

• Hands-on expertise in Oracle to PostgreSQL migration.

• Advanced SQL and query performance tuning skills.

• Experience with AWS SCT and AWS DMS.

• Knowledge of Flyway/Liquibase or similar schema migration tools.

• PostgreSQL internals: indexing, statistics, execution plans.

• AWS services: RDS/Aurora, CloudWatch, IAM (preferred).

You will be preferred if:

• Familiarity with automation and configuration management tools, such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.

• Familiarity with IAAC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation.

• Familiarity with CI/CD implementation tools like Liquibase/Flyway.

• AWS Certified Database - Specialty.

• AWS Certified Solutions Architect.

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager
VA Loan Guaranty (LGY) Program | Full-Time W-2 | Fully Remote (U.S.)
The Problem We're Hiring You to Solve
Every month, your product decisions reach Veterans buying homes, the lenders who close their loans, the servicers who manage them, and the VA staff who stand behind the guaranty.
We are hiring a Product Manager for the modernization of the VA Loan Guaranty (LGY) technology portfolio. The job is translation under pressure: statute, policy, and a sprawling stakeholder ecosystem on one side, a backlog that ships to production every 30 days on the other, while a 20-year-old legacy platform keeps running until the modern one replaces it. If you can hold the Veteran, the lender, and the regulation in your head at the same time, keep reading.
The Opportunity
Most product roles let you invent demand. This one hands you something rarer: a product whose demand is guaranteed by law, which means every ounce of product discipline goes into making the experience better instead of making the funnel bigger.
The LGY portfolio spans the loan guaranty lifecycle: origination-adjacent workflows, servicing oversight and loss mitigation, claims, housing grants, and analytics. The modern platform is Salesforce-centered and configuration-first, supplemented by serverless capabilities in a government cloud. Users include VA program staff and thousands of external lender and servicer users.
The rhythm is fast and formal. Business needs enter through an intake process that produces an executable plan, with refined scope and level of effort, in days. Development runs on a monthly release cadence with an explicit quality bar: acceptance criteria sharp enough to support automated testing, defect detection above 95% before user acceptance testing, and accessibility built into every story. Your requirements are the first link in that quality chain.
You will partner with an Enterprise Solution Architect who owns the designs, an Engineering Lead who owns delivery, and a DevSecOps Lead who owns the platform. You own what gets built, in what order, and why.
What You'll Own

• The backlog as an instrument of the mission. Turn business needs and policy changes into refined, traceable user stories with acceptance criteria precise enough that engineers build the right thing and testers can automate against it.

• Intake to executable plan, fast. Drive new needs from raw business intent to a scoped, estimated, committed plan in days, working shoulder to shoulder with architecture and engineering.

• The roadmap across the portfolio. Sequence modernization, sustainment, and legacy decommissioning, and keep the roadmap credible enough that the customer plans against it.

• A stakeholder ecosystem, not a stakeholder. Balance VA program officials, field staff, and external lender and servicer users whose interests do not always align.

• Value in every release. Own prioritization so every 30-day release ships something stakeholders can name, and coordinate user acceptance testing that runs smoothly because the criteria were right from the start.

• The configure-versus-customize conversation. The program mandates configuration-first solutions. You represent the business value side of those tradeoffs and know when to fight for a custom exception.

• Decisions informed by data. Ground prioritization in analytics, usage, and operational metrics, and push for instrumentation where it does not exist yet.

• The transition experience. As functions move from legacy to modern, sequence the change so lenders, servicers, and VA staff are brought along rather than surprised.

AI-Native Product Management
AI is part of how PhoenixTeam works, and product management may have more to gain from it than any other discipline on the program.

description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model - it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.
Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide - including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more - have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.
So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology-and your hard work!
About the Role
Our customers with the most demanding deployments subscribe to Advanced Services. These are the enterprises where Solace is carrying something the business cannot do without, and where an outage is a business event rather than a support ticket. They pay for a higher standard of service, and the Service Owner is accountable.
You carry a portfolio of these customers and you own their experience of Solace : how well we understand their environment, how quickly problems get found, how clearly we explain what we are doing about them, and whether the platform keeps up with where their business is heading. This is a continuous relationship rather than a project, and it does not get handed off at the end of a phase. It is yours.
What You’ll Do
Own the customer relationship

• Be the named technical contact for a portfolio of Advanced Services customers, and the person inside Solace who understands their environment best

• Build the kind of relationship where their architects call you before they make a decision rather than after

• Report on service quality and the health of their estate in a way both their engineers and their leadership can act on

• Advise them on where the Solace platform is going and which parts of it are worth their attention

• Maintain ownership of all open support tickets for your accounts, ensuring they are progressed, accurately documented, and closed promptly

• Produce and deliver service status reports for every customer with different levels of detail and frequencies

Own the quality of the service

• Keep your customers' environments under active watch so that problems are found by us and not reported by them

• Take issues end to end: triage, resolution, documentation and follow-up, including the ones nobody else wants to pick up

• Pull in Support, Engineering and the account team when an issue needs them, and stay accountable for the outcome until it is closed

• Hold the line on the standard. If the service is falling short for one of your customers, you should be the first to know it and the first to say so

Get new customers to steady state

• Lead onboarding for new Advanced Services customers and bring them to a stable, well-understood steady state

• Keep onboarding on schedule and raise blockers early instead of letting a date slide quietly

• Keep adjusting after go-live until the service fits how the customer actually operates

Keep customers ahead of their own growth

You’ll own our contract lifecycle - tracking every agreement from draft to signature to renewal, and digging into redlines with a sharp eye - while also managing the vendor relationships behind our printing and physical material operations. title: Sr Staff AI Engineer - Veza
description:
The Access AI team is the customer-obsessed engineering group building the agentic AI and enterprise-scale harness platform that powers agents for Access Management across all Identity Security Products. We build AI as foundational platform infrastructure - prioritizing robustness, performance, safety, and real-world customer impact at scale.
Types of problems you’ll get to work on
You will architect, build, and operate production-grade agentic AI systems-autonomous agents that reason over enterprise data and execute mission-critical identity security actions at Fortune 500 scale. As a tier-one technical leader at the intersection of Agent research and large-scale backend systems, you will shape the architectural patterns, scalability guardrails, and strategic vision for autonomous enterprise security.
Your core focus areas:

• Agentic architecture. Design and ship multi-agent systems - orchestration, tool use, planning loops, memory, and failure recovery - that operate reliably in production, not in notebooks.

• Enterprise-grounded reasoning. Build agents that leverage Access Graph, Access Reviews, and permission and risk data - to make decisions with context no frontier model has on its own.

• Trust, safety, and governance. Own the guardrails: observability, human-in-the-loop controls, and compliance infrastructure that make autonomous systems safe to deploy at scale.

• Retrieval and grounding. Work closely with our different product teams, platform and graph teams to ensure agents are grounded in accurate, low-latency retrieval - RAG pipelines, semantic search, re-ranking, and evaluation - as a critical dependency of agentic quality.

• Model integration and evaluation. Integrate frontier models, evaluate trade-offs across cost, latency, and capability for production use cases.

• Engineering leadership. Raise the technical bar through architecture decisions, code reviews, and coaching - particularly on agentic design patterns and production AI discipline.

Qualifications
To be successful in this role you have:

• 8+ years of software engineering with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

• Hands-on depth designing, shipping, and operating agentic systems in production - multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, planning loops, memory, and failure recovery. Not prototypes.

• Production-grade Python. Systems language (Go, Java, or C++) is a plus.

• Working experience with frontier AI SDKs (Anthropic, Google, or OpenAI) - prompt engineering, structured outputs, and model evaluation in production settings.

• Familiarity with RAG and retrieval patterns in production - vector stores, hybrid search, and retrieval evaluation metrics.

• Track record of technical leadership: architecture ownership, code quality bar-raising, and mentoring engineers on production AI practices.

Nice to Have

• Deeper specialization in search and retrieval at scale or MLOps/model observability.

• Published work or open-source contributions in agentic systems or retrieval.

• Exposure to LLM fine-tuning or inference optimization in production.

Why join us
Intelligence is commoditizing. Context and execution are not. With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises in Fortune 500 trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance, we are building the system that makes AI actually work inside the enterprise to secure Enterprises.
Redefining Agentic Identity Governance:

• Agentic Search: Provides natural language, context-aware discovery capabilities across complex permission graphs, enabling rapid identification of access risks and opportunities.

• Agentic Access Reviews: Streamlines certification processes by using autonomous agents to analyze risk and suggest remediation, significantly reducing reviewer fatigue and preventing rubber-stamping by automating User Access Reviews.

title: Talent Partner
description:
Build the team that builds Conveo. As our London Talent Partner, you'll source and close top talent across the UK, US and Belgium as we scale past 100 people.

Conveo is a Y Combinator-backed company in an active growth period. We're scaling past 100 people and delivering our 2027 hiring plan. The people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how this company is built.

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We're investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.

WHAT WE’RE BUILDING

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer and B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Canva use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

THE ROLE

As Talent Partner at Conveo, you will build the team that builds the company. You'll join a small, lean talent team and play a big part in how we scale. You'll play a key part in how Conveo attracts, assesses, and ultimately hires talent across the US, UK, and Belgium, helping us scale past 100 people and deliver our 2027 hiring plan.

You'll close exceptional talent across engineering, product, go-to-market, and operations, while contributing to hiring strategy and talent decisions. You won't be limited to one area. You'll work with stakeholders and leadership across departments. If your experience leans towards one area, such as product and engineering, go-to-market, or operations, that's fine. We're open to candidates with a variety of backgrounds.

This isn't a transactional recruiting role. You'll shape how candidates experience Conveo and help build a team with high talent density for the long term. Proactive sourcing and strong execution will be central to your success.

Talent operations plays a small part in this role. Lots of foundations are already in place, and you'll help build on them as we scale. If you like to experiment and work with the latest tech, especially AI, you'll find this role really interesting.

We're growing fast, so priorities shift and you'll often make calls with imperfect information.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own hiring outcomes end-to-end

- Partner closely with hiring managers and leadership

- Own roles from kickoff to close, including sourcing and closing

- Maintain speed without sacrificing quality

- Develop strong hiring judgment

Build proactive talent pipelines

- Develop centralised talent pipelines across key disciplines, enabling the business to take a broader and more proactive approach to hiring

- Create innovative sourcing strategies for particular searches, incorporating AI-enabled sourcing, targeted outbound campaigns, market mapping, events, and external communities

- Proactively source top-tier talent using LinkedIn, Juicebox, and other tools. Our toolkit isn't fixed. We're always looking at new tools, and deciding whether to build them internally or use them externally, to level up our sourcing and recruitment capabilities.

- Provide external talent intelligence, including candidate availability, competitor activity, compensation, and wider market trends

Build a high-signal candidate experience

- Be the main point of contact and advocate for candidates

- Every candidate hears back from us quickly, whether it's a yes or a no.

- Pitch Conveo with real conviction, because you understand the product, the market and why people join.

Grow our employer brand

- Contribute to employer branding content that shows what it's like to work at Conveo

- Support events that put Conveo in front of top talent

Build scalable hiring and people systems

- Improve interview loops, scorecards, and decision-making

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
About Runware

Runware is the AI inference platform that builds and runs its own infrastructure, end to end. Our Sonic Inference Engine has served more than 20 billion requests for over 1 million developers and 500 million end users, with 400,000+ models behind a single integration, at up to 10x lower cost per token than traditional providers.
We are now building the AI Factory that runs it. The Sonic Inference Pod packs 1 MW of custom-designed compute into a 20-foot container with closed-loop, water-free cooling, sited wherever power exists. Pods are live in the US and Europe, and we are scaling to dozens of pods and tens of thousands of GPUs, all operated as one distributed fabric that reroutes traffic the moment a pod goes offline (announcement).
Every one of those pods holds customer models, customer data and millions of dollars of GPUs, sometimes inside a customer's own perimeter or a sovereign jurisdiction. Keeping all of it secure without slowing anyone down is the job.
The role
As Senior Security Engineer, you will own the security of Runware 's AI supercomputer: the bare-metal GPU fleet, the Sonic Inference Pods it lives in, the managed Kubernetes clusters we hand to customers, and the control plane that ties it all together across the US and Europe. You will design the controls, build the first version with your own hands, and set the standard for how security is run across every pod.
This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. You will threat-model a new pod before it ships, harden the image that every GPU node boots from, prove to an enterprise customer's security team that their model weights never leave their tenant, and when something goes wrong, lead the response and fix the root cause so it never happens again. You will work directly with our CISO, with the inference engine, platform and hardware teams, and with the site teams deploying pods.
Success means a customer workload on a shared pod is isolated as strongly as on a dedicated one, no human has a standing login to a production node, every change to the fleet is reviewed, signed and auditable, and an enterprise security review takes days instead of months.
What you'll do

• Own the security architecture of the fleet: host hardening for bare-metal GPU nodes, immutable images and a signed build pipeline, boot integrity, and the identity, secrets and access model for humans and services across every pod.

• Secure multi-tenancy on shared infrastructure. Design and verify isolation between customer workloads at the network, Kubernetes, host and GPU layers, and produce the evidence that proves it holds.

• Secure the managed Kubernetes offering: cluster hardening, admission control, RBAC, supply-chain controls for images, and a clean, auditable handover of clusters to customers.

• Build security visibility across the fleet: logging, detection, alerting and audit trails from firmware to API, wired into the fleet dashboards and on-call so that an anomaly on one node in one pod is seen within minutes.

• Lead security reviews and threat models for new pods, sites, servers and platform features, with a focus on real-world risk rather than checklists.

• Run incident response for the infrastructure: investigation, containment, recovery and post-incident learning, as part of the on-call rotation.

• Own vulnerability management for the fleet: firmware, kernel, drivers, GPU stack and container images across thousands of nodes, with a patch cadence you can defend to a customer.

• Answer enterprise customers' security due diligence with engineering evidence, and partner with the CISO on the SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls that touch the infrastructure.

• Design for sovereign and on-premise deployments: data residency, in-country key management, and physical and remote-access controls for a pod sitting on a customer's site.

title: Deal Desk Strategy Lead
description:
Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era
At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift, we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.
The Deal Desk Strategy Lead owns both the strategic and operational aspects of deals while serving as a Lead for Contract Operations. This is an individual contributor role with you personally handling complex, high-value deals while providing support and an initial escalation path for less complex and more standard deals managed by Contract Operations.

Deal Strategy is a concierge-style function that supports Sales across the full deal lifecycle so reps can focus on selling. As an individual contributor, you’ll personally own complex, high-value deals. You’ll also be the first escalation point and mentor for Contract Operations, which handles more standard deals.
What You’ll Do:

•
Structure deals and contracts: Act as Sales’ primary partner on intake and strategy. Balance revenue goals, pricing and discount policy, product configuration, and customer health. Be the escalation point for non-standard commercial structures.

•
Partner cross-functionally: Work with FinOps (rev rec, payment, accounting), Finance (terms, discounts), and Legal (non-standard terms). Secure deal approvals and keep sales leadership aligned.

•
Own documentation and systems: Generate quotes (CPQ), order forms, and contracts. Manage redlines, playbooks, fallbacks, and pre-approved clauses with Legal. Keep Salesforce deal data accurate and troubleshoot tooling issues.

•
Drive deals to close: Coordinate stakeholders, route documents for signature, file executed contracts, and confirm rev rec steps are complete.

•
Provide ongoing support: Stay active in Slack, be on call for deal discussions, and offer extended availability at quarter-end.

•
Mentor and coach: Develop junior team members and help monitor team KPIs (turnaround time, quote accuracy, approval cycle time). Review recommendations before they go to Sales or Finance leadership.

Who You Are:

• 7+ years in Deal Desk, Contract Management, Sales Ops, or similar at a B2B SaaS or technology company

• 4+ years coaching or mentoring a contract management team

• Experience with complex enterprise deals and subscription models

• Strong grasp of quote-to-cash, pricing and discounting frameworks, and rev rec impacts

• Skill drafting legal language from playbooks and redlining commercial contracts

• Excellent stakeholder management, with the ability to influence without authority

• Sound decision-making within your approval levels, strong analytical skills, and attention to detail

• Comfort with ambiguity and building structure

• Salesforce experience strongly preferred; Ironclad workflow experience a plus

What Success Looks Like:

• Sales leadership sees you as a strategic partner, not a bottleneck

• Deal cycle times fall while approval quality and compliance improve

• The team gains autonomy and escalations decrease

• Policies are documented, current, and transparent

Pay Transparency Range: ($116,767.00 - 175,151.00)

title: AI-native Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
👋 About Us
At bookingkit , Europe's leading booking and reservation software for tours and activities, big changes are on the horizon. Our goal by 2030 is to create an AI-powered Success Platform enabling Attractions like museums, sights, and theme parks to grow ticket sales and simplify ticket operations.
We’re digitising Europe’s tours & activities industry and helping experience providers grow. We’re now building the AI layer on top of our platform, and we’re hiring an AI-native Product Manager (m/f/d) to lead it.
You’ll own discovery, definition and delivery of AI capabilities for two audiences. The first are the bookingkit customers who run attractions and tours (B2B): you’ll help them operate their business better by taking faster, smarter decisions on pricing, availability and distribution. The second is their guests (B2B2C): you’ll make experiences discoverable and bookable wherever guests shop, including through AI assistants and agents. The work spans natural-language features, MCP servers and agentic systems, all with one goal: helping our customers sell more tickets, safely.
This is a full-time (40h/week) position. Berlin-based candidates can join us at the office 1-2 days per week, while remote candidates can work from anywhere in Europe with sufficient time-zone overlap.
Hybrid or remote , the work setup choice is yours!
🎯 What You'll Own

•
Own the roadmap for bookingkit ’s AI capabilities across two tracks:

• Customers of bookingkit (B2B): agents and tools that recommend, and where appropriate execute, actions e.g. on pricing, availability and channel allocation, or order management

• Guests of our customers ( B2B2C ): discovery and shopping experiences, including making inventory bookable by third-party AI assistants via MCP and emerging agentic-commerce standards.

• Run continuous discovery with customers, partners and internal teams (sales, CS, support). Find where AI creates measurable value and turn it into prioritized opportunities and clear requirements.

• Lead co-development with selected customers, taking concepts from prototype to scoped pilot to a reusable, generally available capability.

• Drive delivery end-to-end with engineering and design, from spec through launch and iteration. Support other product managers and teams on their projects.

• Define what “good” means for each AI feature: success metrics, evaluation sets, quality thresholds and instrumentation. Use them to decide what ships, what gets iterated and what gets cut.

•
Set the guardrails for agent autonomy:

• which actions agents can take on a customer’s behalf, and when a human must approve;

• how actions are logged and reversed;

• working with engineering, security and legal on reliability, GDPR and EU AI Act requirements.

• Own the trade-offs between quality, cost and latency, including build/buy and model/vendor choices.

• Partner with marketing on go-to-market, and own the documentation (help centre and setup guides) so customers can adopt these capabilities on their own.

• Contribute to improving and automating our internal product processes through agentic AI flows.

🧠 What You Bring

• 3+ years in product management in B2B SaaS, including at least one AI/LLM-powered capability shipped to real customers, not just prototyped.

• A working understanding of how LLM products are built (prompting, retrieval, tool calling and agents, evaluations) and how they fail. You need enough depth to make trade-offs with engineers.

• You’re a hands-on builder. You prototype with API clients, notebooks or AI coding tools to test an idea before you spec it, and AI tools are part of your everyday workflow.

• Hands-on experience running co-development or pilot programs.

• Proven, practical use of AI tools in product work (research, writing, analysis, prototyping) and improving product processes through AI - specifically in setting up and improving internal AI agents
